highlights.headline: Trump’s EPA reportedly ⁠poised to axe carbon pollution rules for power plants
highlights.summary: <p>Advocates and experts describe the Trump administration’s climate rollbacks as gifts to polluters at expense of planet</p><p>The US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) is ⁠poised to formally repeal carbon pollution standards for coal- and gas-fired power plants, according to reports.</p><p>The Trump administration’s latest climate rollback is expected to ⁠come as soon as Monday on the sidelines of the G20 energy ministers’ meeting in Houston, ⁠Texas, Bloomberg

items.title: Yemen's Houthis attack Saudis, seize crucial Red Sea islands
items.description: Iran-backed Houthi rebels have tightened their grip on a key shipping route, capturing two strategic Red Sea islands. The closure of another global transport route is the latest ripple effect of the US war with Iran.

items.title: Finland: EU leaders meet to forge new Arctic policy
items.description: European leaders are meeting over shipping, resources and security in the region amid pressure from the US, China and Russia. The EU sees the Arctic as key to its future security as melting ice makes it more accessible.

items.title: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
items.description: The former UK PM said: "I don't know what warped logic drove Putin to blow up a stationary Ukrainian locomotive on the Polish border this morning".

items.title: EU leaders urge unity after Russian strike on train
items.description: Russia's drone attack on a train near the Ukraine-Poland border has triggered EU calls to up support for Kyiv. Allies of Ukraine should show they "are not scared," said the bloc's top diplomat, Kaja Kallas.

items.title: Watch: Why a Russian strike on train near Ukraine-Poland border could mark an escalation
items.description: No casualties were reported after a Russian drone struck a train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials left the area.
